settings.label: How to measure
settings.body: Stand on a sheet of paper with your heel to a wall, mark the tip of your longest toe, and measure heel to mark.

settings.label: Between two sizes
settings.body: Between two bands? Take the larger one. These are a close, stretchy fit — a size down grips the toes and shortens the life of the membrane.

settings.question: Three-layer construction
settings.answer: A knitted lining next to the skin, a licensed Porelle® waterproof-breathable membrane, and a knitted outer that takes the abrasion. Bonded, not stitched together.

settings.question: What it will not do
settings.answer: Water over the cuff still gets in, and no waterproof sock behaves otherwise. Every limit we know about is published rather than left for you to find.

settings.question: Materials and care
settings.answer: A cool machine wash. No fabric conditioner and no tumble dryer — one coats a membrane and the other degrades it.

settings.question: Are these actually waterproof, or just water resistant?
settings.answer: Waterproof. The middle layer is a Porelle® membrane — a licensed third-party laminate, not a name we invented — sealed inside a three-layer knit. Water that goes in over the top of the cuff is inside the sock, and no waterproof sock behaves otherwise.

settings.question: Will my feet still sweat?
settings.answer: If you work hard enough, yes. The membrane moves vapour out, which delays the point at which the foot is wet from the inside. It does not repeal it. Breathable and dry are not the same word.

settings.question: Do they replace waterproof boots?
settings.answer: No. They are one component of a system. If your footwear is wrong for the ground you are on, a sock will not fix it.

settings.question: What size should I order?
settings.answer: Four bands: S covers UK 3-5, M covers UK 6-8, L covers UK 9-11, XL covers UK 12-14. The size guide opens over the buy widget without leaving the page, and it is measurement-led — shoe sizing is not consistent between brands.

settings.question: How much is delivery?
settings.answer: Free UK delivery on two pairs or more. On a single pair, delivery is charged at checkout and shown before you pay. No delivery speed is printed anywhere on this site, because we will not promise one that confirmed stock cannot support.

settings.question: Why are there no reviews on this site?
settings.answer: Because there are none yet. HydroSox is new, and a rating with nothing behind it is worth nothing. When there is real review volume it will be published here — including the reviews that do not flatter us.
